row: JYphysiotherapy provides informative videos to assist with current patients being treated as well those looking for video resources. The videos include advise on STRETCHING, CORRECT TECHNIQUE, STRENGTHENING FOR SPECIFIC INJURIES. The videos shown are general advise and it is often advised to get a personal assessment. If any of the items shown give any pain or discomfort please stop straight away.
